parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name FROM architecture.projects p WHERE p.slug = $1;
SELECT id FROM architecture.jobs WHERE project_id = $1 AND stage = 'solution-architecture' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO architecture.jobs (project_id, stage, input_job_id, status, meta) VALUES ($1, 'risk-assessment', $2, 'running', $3::jsonb) RETURNING id, stage, status;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.type) a.type, a.content FROM architecture.artifacts a WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.type IN ('brd', 'business_arch', 'application_arch', 'data_arch', 'infrastructure_arch', 'solution_arch_md', 'openapi_yaml', 'asyncapi_yaml', 'sql_schema_sql') ORDER BY a.type, a.version DESC;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'risk_assessment_md') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'risk_assessment_md', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;
